senses.gloss:
a. 
(-री f.) [उदुम्बर-अञ्] 
__1 Made of, or coming from, the Udumbara tree. 
__2 Made of copper; पात्रमौदुम्बरं गृह्य [[Mb. 13. 125. 82.]] 
-रः [[[P. IV. 2. 67.]]] 
__1 N. of a region abounding in Udumbara trees. 
__2 A form of Yama, the god of death. 
__3 Made of copper. 
__4 A class of ascetics solely living on whatever fruits they see first early in the morning; [[Bhāg. 3. 12. 43.]] 
-री A branch of the Udumbara tree. 
-रम् 
__1 The wood of the Udumbara tree. 
__2 The Udumbara fruit. 
__3 A kind of leprosy. 
__4 Copper or a copper-vessel; [[Mb. 5. 40. 10.]]
A place full of Udumbara trees.
N. of a grammarian. इन्द्रियनित्यं वचनमौदुम्बराणः [[Nir.]]
